notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:
-Crops can no longer be planted where other crops are
-Dialog works properly
-NPCs no longer face only left
-Game doesn't crash when talking to NPC while holding item
-Shops properly subtract required resources
-Crops and dragon properly age

Quality of Life Changes:
-Shipping bin shows total value of all items in it
-White square to show where player is interacting
-Changed interact button to E
-Changed inventory button to I
-ESC opens Controls panel
